public_body: West Brookfield Housing Authority Board Of Directors
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a meeting and by requesting and photographing attendees' identification, but found no violation for failing to announce a recording.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly deliberated outside a posted meeting when it chose a member to chair the portion of the meeting addressing a specific attendee.
allegations.key_passage: We find, therefore, that the decision to have Mr. Fernandes serve as acting chair was made outside of a posted open meeting, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Acting chair allegedly asked a member of the public and his wife for identification and photographed it at a board meeting, which may have deterred attendance.
allegations.key_passage: A request to review and photograph the identification of a person who has expressed criticism of the public body presents an unacceptable risk of discouraging public attendance.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly failed to announce at the start of the meeting that the session was being recorded by a staff member taking minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because Acting Chair Fernandes was required to announce only those recordings of which he was aware, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law when he did not do so.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
